candidates.title: Akira
candidates.reason: A dystopian cyberpunk film whose clandestine psychic experiments and Tetsuo's escalating telekinetic abilities drive an increasingly destructive mystery. The 124-minute film combines sustained violent action, graphic body horror and a grim Neo-Tokyo setting with exceptionally distinctive hand-drawn animation. The investigation and revelation of Akira's nature are meaningful, but psychological out-thinking and a formal trainable power system are weaker than its spectacle; a substantial military presence and retro visual language are also relevant limitations. The feature's overall action intensity and graphic violence are supported by whole-film reviews rather than trailer footage.

research_rejections.title: Rick and Morty: The Anime
research_rejections.reason: The complete first season has mixed critical reception, with critics citing inconsistent writing and uneven animation. Although multiverse mysteries and unusual visuals are present, whole-season evidence does not support a confident fit to the baseline's core psychological strategy, progression and action dimensions; not submitted as a candidate.
